notes: Hand-verified against the scenario's own arithmetic before comparing to reference-model output:

Opening (2026-01-01): cash 200000.00 (debit) / paid_in_capital 200000.00 (credit). Formation: debit investment_in_subsidiary 100000.00, credit cash 100000.00 -> cash 100000.00. Loan funded: debit intercompany_receivable 50000.00, credit cash 50000.00 -> cash 50000.00.

2026: interest received 3000.00 (debit cash, credit intercompany_interest_income) -> cash 53000.00, intercompany_interest_income 3000.00 (period activity). Closing 2026-12-31 sweeps the 3000.00 into retained_earnings. End-of-2026 balance sheet: assets cash 53000.00 + investment_in_subsidiary 100000.00 + intercompany_receivable 50000.00 = 203000.00 = liabilities+equity paid_in_capital 200000.00 + retained_earnings 3000.00 = 203000.00.

2027: a second 3000.00 interest receipt (same as 2026, fresh period activity since the 2026 closing excluded it from 2027's window), plus the 50000.00 balloon principal repayment (debit cash, credit intercompany_receivable) -> cash 53000.00 + 3000.00 + 50000.00 = 106000.00; intercompany_receivable 50000.00 - 50000.00 = 0.00. Closing 2027-12-31 sweeps the second 3000.00 into retained_earnings -> 3000.00 + 3000.00 = 6000.00. End-of-2027 balance sheet: assets cash 106000.00 + investment_in_subsidiary 100000.00 + intercompany_receivable 0.00 = 206000.00 = paid_in_capital 200000.00 + retained_earnings 6000.00 = 206000.00.

Cash flow 2026: investment_in_subsidiary and intercompany_receivable are both tagged cash_flow_category: investing, so investing_cash_flow = -100000.00 - 50000.00 = -150000.00; operating_cash_flow = net_income 3000.00 + paid_in_capital 200000.00 (an untagged equity account, defaults to operating) = 203000.00; 203000.00 - 150000.00 = 53000.00, matching ending_cash 53000.00 - beginning_cash 0.00.
